instruction:
You are an equipment review engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-06 equipment datasheet and commissioning review package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Datasheet review, POR/AOR screening, commissioning, and review-comment workflows shape the context only; this instance does not run external software or parse a real source pack.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-06-LH-08`
- Equipment schedule: `EQUIP-06-SCHED-08`
- Manufacturer datasheet: `DATASHEET-06-MFR-08`
- Curve/table export: `CURVE-06-EXPORT-08`
- Commissioning checklist: `COMM-06-CHECK-08`
- Review comments: `REVIEW-06-COMMENTS-08`
- Review response: `MEMO-06-REVIEW-08`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Scheduled duty flow | {{ scheduled_flow_l_s }} L/s |
| Datasheet max flow | {{ datasheet_max_flow_l_s }} L/s |
| Scheduled duty head | {{ scheduled_head_m }} m |
| Datasheet max head | {{ datasheet_max_head_m }} m |
| BEP flow | {{ bep_flow_l_s }} L/s |
| POR lower bound | {{ por_lower_pct }} % of BEP |
| POR upper bound | {{ por_upper_pct }} % of BEP |
| NPSH available | {{ npsh_available_m }} m |
| NPSH required | {{ npsh_required_m }} m |
| Shaft power | {{ shaft_power_kw }} kW |
| Selected motor size | {{ selected_motor_kw }} kW |
| Motor service factor | {{ motor_service_factor }} |
| Provided evidence count | {{ provided_evidence_count }} |
| Required evidence count | {{ required_evidence_count }} |
| Open commissioning items | {{ open_commissioning_items }} |
| Critical review comments open | {{ critical_review_comments_open }} |

## Calculation Rules

- Flow capacity margin percent equals `(datasheet max flow - scheduled flow) / scheduled flow x 100`.
- Head capacity margin percent equals `(datasheet max head - scheduled head) / scheduled head x 100`.
- POR position percent equals scheduled flow divided by BEP flow times 100.
- POR margin percent equals the smaller margin to the lower and upper POR bounds.
- NPSH margin equals NPSH available minus NPSH required.
- Motor service margin equals selected motor size minus shaft power times motor service factor.
- Evidence completeness score equals provided evidence count divided by required evidence count.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when capacity, POR, NPSH, motor, evidence completeness, and critical-comment checks pass.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated modelling evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "flow_capacity_margin_pct": <numeric_value>,
  "head_capacity_margin_pct": <numeric_value>,
  "por_position_pct": <numeric_value>,
  "por_margin_pct": <numeric_value>,
  "npsh_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "motor_service_margin_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "evidence_completeness_score": <numeric_value>,
  "open_commissioning_items": <numeric_value>,
  "critical_review_comments_open": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-06 equipment datasheet and commissioning review template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one schedule, datasheet, curve export, commissioning checklist, and review-comment source pack.

[meta]
name = "equipment-datasheet-commissioning-review-package"
description = "SSC-06 equipment datasheet and commissioning review metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound equipment datasheet and commissioning review metrics from a deterministic SSC-06 task-owned source pack. The template combines flow/head capacity margins, POR/AOR position, NPSH and motor margins, evidence completeness, open commissioning items, critical review comments, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "equipment-review-commissioning"
standards = ["pump datasheet review workflow", "POR/AOR screening", "commissioning checklist workflow"]
tags = ["mechanical", "equipment", "datasheet", "commissioning", "por", "aor", "review", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.scheduled_flow_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "EQUIP-06-SCHED-08 scheduled duty flow"
min = 78.0
max = 78.0

[params.datasheet_max_flow_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "DATASHEET-06-MFR-08 datasheet maximum flow"
min = 85.0
max = 85.0

[params.scheduled_head_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "EQUIP-06-SCHED-08 scheduled duty head"
min = 24.5
max = 24.5

[params.datasheet_max_head_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "DATASHEET-06-MFR-08 datasheet maximum head"
min = 27.5
max = 27.5

[params.bep_flow_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "CURVE-06-EXPORT-08 best-efficiency-point flow"
min = 82.0
max = 82.0

[params.por_lower_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "CURVE-06-EXPORT-08 POR lower bound as percent of BEP flow"
min = 70.0
max = 70.0

[params.por_upper_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "CURVE-06-EXPORT-08 POR upper bound as percent of BEP flow"
min = 110.0
max = 110.0

[params.npsh_available_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "COMM-06-CHECK-08 NPSH available"
min = 10.6
max = 10.6

[params.npsh_required_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "CURVE-06-EXPORT-08 NPSH required"
min = 7.8
max = 7.8

[params.shaft_power_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "CURVE-06-EXPORT-08 shaft power"
min = 26.0
max = 26.0

[params.selected_motor_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "EQUIP-06-SCHED-08 selected motor size"
min = 30.0
max = 30.0

[params.motor_service_factor]
type = "float"
description = "DATASHEET-06-MFR-08 motor service factor"
min = 1.15
max = 1.15

[params.provided_evidence_count]
type = "float"
description = "REVIEW-06-COMMENTS-08 evidence items provided"
min = 7.0
max = 7.0

[params.required_evidence_count]
type = "float"
description = "REVIEW-06-COMMENTS-08 evidence items required"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.open_commissioning_items]
type = "float"
description = "COMM-06-CHECK-08 open commissioning items"
min = 2.0
max = 2.0

[params.critical_review_comments_open]
type = "float"
description = "REVIEW-06-COMMENTS-08 critical review comments still open"
min = 0.0
max = 0.0

[outputs.flow_capacity_margin_pct]
description = "Datasheet flow capacity margin"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.head_capacity_margin_pct]
description = "Datasheet head capacity margin"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.por_position_pct]
description = "Scheduled duty flow as a percent of BEP flow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.por_margin_pct]
description = "Nearest POR bound margin"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.npsh_margin_m]
description = "NPSH available minus NPSH required"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.motor_service_margin_kw]
description = "Selected motor size minus service-factor-adjusted shaft power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.evidence_completeness_score]
description = "Provided evidence count divided by required evidence count"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.open_commissioning_items]
description = "Open commissioning item count"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.critical_review_comments_open]
description = "Critical review comments still open"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when capacity, POR, NPSH, motor, evidence, and critical comment checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001
